newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Canada to expand agricultural ties with Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Canada to expand agricultural ties with Indonesia.

text.p: Canadian Agriculture Minister Ralph Goodale said on Wednesday his country was seeking to expand cooperation in the agricultural sector with Indonesia, especially in meat processing.

"I think there are opportunities to expand, with respect to meat processing, with respect to a whole variety of other kinds of processed food products," he told reporters after talks with President Suharto in Jakarta.
There are also opportunities in livestock genetics, and areas related to the exchange of science and technology in relation to agriculture, he said.
Goodale said he had a "lively discussion" with Suharto on the breeding of beef and dairy cattle -- an area in which Suharto takes a personal interest, having his own cattle ranch.
"A good level of cooperation already exists between Canada and Indonesia in agriculture and food issues," said Goodale, who ends his three-day Indonesian visit on Friday.
